name: Planisware Singapore Pte. Ltd
notes: Planisware develops and provides Planisware Enterprise and Planisware Orchestra —two Enterprise Project Portfolio Management (PPM) applications—which are delivered globally via its internal cloud infrastructure, and its own BGP backbone, spanning 3 areas (US, EU, Asia). They serve a range of industries, including energy, medical devices, high-tech, aerospace and defense, chemicals, government, pharmaceutical, and automotive.
